concepts.name: A · 夜航展厅
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE highly art-directed finished desktop website HOMEPAGE / entrance concept for a personal interactive miniature-room portfolio. Landscape 16:9, high resolution 2400x1350 or similar. This is a design proposal for approval, not a screenshot of implemented software. Input image is a reference for the EXISTING room only: preserve recognizable thick graphite curved walls, huge panoramic city window, left display with orange/ice-blue sculpture, rounded three-cell right showcase, red-brown lounge chair, curved work desk, office chair and small objects, rounded platform. Recompose that room as the main visual. No new room, human avatar, astronaut, invented art projects or invented biography. Existing small robot is allowed.
Typography: unusually bold, artistic CHINESE rounded black display lettering, approximating the user's chosen ChillRoundGothic Heavy 900 (寒蝉圆黑体); visibly thick short embossed/extruded edges with tasteful warm highlights, not calligraphy, not Kai or Song style. Body text crisp restrained sans serif. Intentional asymmetry and strong hierarchy, real editorial graphic design, generous negative space, careful optical spacing. All web controls must look implementable in HTML/CSS; polished 3D room compositing. NO dashboard, neon HUD, fake telemetry, random numbers, debug labels, floating glass cards, generic SaaS layout, excessive pills, purple gradient, sci-fi hexagon borders, browser chrome or device frame.
Exact Chinese UI copy only as needed: top identity “创作空间” with small “个人作品集”; top right navigation “作品” “关于” “联系”; primary button “进入房间” with arrow; secondary text “静音进入”; small instruction “拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放 · 点击探索”; quiet footer “个人资料与作品待补充”. Show a tasteful genuine loading-ready indicator “房间已就绪” if suitable. No new personal claims. Single edge-to-edge website design, no surrounding moodboard, no multiple panels, no explanatory annotations outside UI.
Direction A — NIGHT GALLERY. Editorial cinematic opening, midnight blue-black with warm ivory and a restrained amber stroke. Build a compelling asymmetrical composition: very large sculptural title “创作” on one line and “空间” below at left, around left 34% width, vertically between 26% and 63% of viewport. Heavy ivory letters have short titanium sides, sophisticated physical depth but excellent readability. Tiny subtitle and large horizontal brushed-metal “进入房间 ↗” control below with quiet secondary 静音进入. RIGHT 62% is the complete existing room on its platform seen from the reference 3/4 angle, stage-like warm interior lamps and cool moonlit edges, generous framing with no cut walls or floor. A restrained architectural dark gallery surround recedes behind it, never empty pure-black void. Keep all text clear of model. Header at 5% margins, tiny orbital signature at left; navigation at right. One fine warm horizontal rule anchors the lower composition. Bottom content is sparse and intentional. Premium art-book cover meets a real industrial designer's portfolio. Room remains more important than decorative effects. No moon or planets outside the existing room window.

Direction B — DAYLIGHT EDITORIAL. A radically different bright homepage, warm ivory/off-white architectural paper background, graphite heavy type and restrained terracotta accent derived from the lounge chair. Editorial museum catalogue composition. Put a GIANT one-line Chinese title “创作空间” across the upper-middle in heavy rounded graphite letters with short beveled sides (not an outline font), below a very thin practical header. Beneath it, the complete existing room appears like a precisely photographed architectural model on a broad pale gallery plinth, primarily at center-right occupying 62% width and 56% height; show strong realistic morning sun from upper left, long crisp diagonal shadow falling into clean ivory negative space. Preserve the room graphite architecture and all main furniture identity from input. A narrow left text/entry column aligns under the title: personal-portfolio eyebrow, very short existing instruction, a weighty rectangular graphite button “进入房间 ↗” with pale typography, 静音进入 quietly underneath. Use refined ruled margins and generous negative space, two or three tiny editorial alignment marks only; no charts or numbered fake work. The visual needs the authority and tactility of an independent design exhibition poster translated into a usable homepage. No dark vignette. Entire room platform inside canvas, no edge crop.

Direction C — BRONZE PORTAL. Rich warm charcoal, desaturated bronze, dark olive-grey and cream. A distinctive tactile precision-instrument entrance, quiet retro-futurist industrial design. Composition is CENTERED: a large single rounded-rectangle architectural aperture with softly squared corners occupies middle 70% width; a very thin layered machined metal bevel frames the exact existing room INSIDE it, as if looking through a physical gallery window. The frame must be elegant and thin, not a heavy dashboard or sci-fi HUD. Room complete at natural 3/4 view, warm lamps, cool nocturnal window, all main existing objects, camera comfortably wide. Bottom of the aperture sits around 70% viewport height. Below it sits a broad compact central sculptural Chinese title “创作空间” in exceptionally bold cream rounded Heavy 900 with bronze relief thickness, followed by ONE centered rectangular machined copper “进入房间 ↗” button and small 静音进入. Title is outside the aperture, legible and not covering the model. Slim top navigation, tiny orbital mark at top left. Subtle metal grain and grazing amber side illumination along the aperture. Small instruction line and personal-data placeholder at bottom edges. Warm craftsmanship and physical materials, no generic glowing rounded cards, no meter dials, fake serial labels, decorative data, stars, holograms or orange neon. Do not resemble variant A's side-by-side layout or variant B's huge top headline.
